integrity: Every enumerative and attaching-degree claim is independently reproduced by the enclosed standard-library Python scripts; no external audit has been performed. The result uses the standard incidence-graph suspension theorem of Tsukuda.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary independence complex of GP(8,3) is classified; no family-wide statement. The full text of Knill, arXiv:2605.30799, was inaccessible, leaving a bibliographic overlap risk.
title: Integral homotopy type of the Möbius–Kantor independence complex
